title: From Code to Correctness: Closing the Last Mile of Code Generation with Hierarchical Debugging
summary: The original MGDebugger pipeline decomposes LLM-generated code into a hierarchy of subfunctions, generates tests for smaller code units, simulates execution to localize failures, fixes subfunctions bottom-up, and then propagates fixes back into the full program.
This reproduction replaces that hierarchical multi-granularity debugging workflow with a simplified single-LLM prompt that directly produces a corrected solution.
